answer_1.quote: For absolute evaluation, we focus on three evaluation criteria: fluency, consistency and coherence, which are widely applied in NLG tasks. We utilize datasets from four tasks: Asset for simplification, SummEval and Newsroom for summarization, WebNLG, SFRES, and SFHOT for data-to-text, and USR-Persona and USR-Topic for dialogue.

answer_2.quote: We introduce RepEval, an evaluation metric utilizing the projection of LLM representation for custom evaluation. For absolute evaluation, experiments on three criteria with ten datasets show that our method has better correlations with human judgments than previous metrics.

answer_4.quote: Human judgment is still the gold-standard approach to text evaluation, which is also the basis of meta-evaluation methods used in this study.
answer_4.guideline: Human judgments were collected by the creators of the datasets following their respective guidelines, which include criteria such as fluency, consistency, coherence, harmlessness, and honesty.
